  Details:
  Direct time (engagement/analysis) — the diagnosis, root-cause analysis, and correction cycles on the DISCORD_ENVOY_GOVERNOR_PARITY plan (thread 30892).
  
  Analysis performed:
  - Diagnosed why Envoy's bot message was silently dropped (no journal trace): it never reached author_role() — it was filtered at the trusted-bot guard because DISCORD_TRUSTED_BOT_IDS was unset (only DISCORD_SENTINEL_USER_IDS was set). Corrected my own earlier "unset" claim against live /proc/<pid>/environ evidence.
  - Root-caused a latent infrastructure gap: deploy_autopilot's no-op guard keys on source (.py) staleness, so an .env-only change always no-ops — and the hand-restart that would load it is blocked by the self-restart guard. The two sanctioned levers cancelled out (the new var had only gone live via an unrelated 16:23:04 restart). Designed + shipped the durable fix (#494).
  - Reframed the underlying cache bug per the governor's architectural point: Discord member/governor resolution is already ID-native (col G), so sentinel resolution should key off the numeric Discord ID too — adapter-only, no tokenomics GAS dependency. Verified at the code level (discord_email() reads col G->col D; nothing reads col W; sentinel_emails() is the only email-keyed step, inherited from the DApp/JWT path).
  - Closed the plan COMPLETE with coherent docs across OPEN_FOLLOWUPS.md, the plan doc, the manifest row, and the regenerated index.json.
  
  Why: distinguishes the human-equivalent analysis/attention from raw machine time, per the standing Sophia raw/direct split convention (OPERATING_INSTRUCTIONS §5b / DAO_CLIENT_AI_AGENT_CONTRIBUTIONS.md).
